component.name: Gitust
component.summary: Tiny, native Git and GitHub client

description.p: Gitust keeps the everyday Git flow (see what changed, stage files, hunks or lines, commit, branch, push) in a native window that starts fast and idles at about 10 MB of memory. No Electron, no web view: one small executable.
Everything local works offline and without an account. Signing in to GitHub adds your repositories, pull requests, issues, notifications and CI checks.
